name: T3 Code
where_agents_run: your machine + another machine you pair or reach over SSH (Linux or Apple Silicon Mac); phone, browser or another desktop app control it through T3 Connect, Tailscale or a local network
source_note: Checked against its README, docs/ folder, source code at commit 4222485, latest stable release (v0.0.43) and t3.codes. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: 6 agents side by side in one sidebar, your own logins

harness_count.value: 6: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity

needs_you_signal.value: Colored thread status, desktop alerts, phone push

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve or reject in chat on desktop, web or phone

cross_provider_delegation.value: All agents in one sidebar; no agent-to-agent hand-off

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat threads with expandable tool calls

real_terminal.value: Chat only; its terminal is for your own commands

session_organization.value: Projects, then threads, optional worktree per thread

prompt_scratchpad.value: Prompt stash saves a prompt without sending

saved_prompt_library.value: Prompt stash with context; no lasting named library

builtin_editors_browser.value: Editor, diff viewer, preview browser, phone emulators

appearance_control.value: Custom themes plus font family and size everywhere

usage_hud.value: Tokens, cost and plan limits with resets per provider

burn_rate_forecast.value: Pace mark per limit; no predicted time to the limit

account_hotswap.value: Several accounts per provider, picked per thread

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Full pull request flow on 6 hosts; no issue intake

worktree_management.value: New worktree per thread, one per model

planner_orchestrator.value: Plan mode for one agent; no splitting across agents

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: No way for one thread to message another

native_mobile_app.value: iOS and Android apps in the stores

phone_no_new_app.value: Hosted web app in the phone browser; needs HTTPS access

remote_ssh.value: Installs its server on a remote host over SSH

voice_input.value: Dictation in the iPhone app only

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux; iOS, Android; any browser

app_shell.value: Electron 44, also served as a web app

background_process.value: Yes: bundled server that runs agents, terminals, git

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus a Node server)

runs_in_terminal.value: No; own desktop, web and phone apps

extensibility.value: No plugins or SDK; custom themes only

stability_maturity.value: v0.0.43, started February 2026; README says very early
